firm_data.firm_description: NESENOFF & MILTENBERG, LLP is a law firm that offers litigation, title IX, and employee discrimination law services in NYC and Boston. They have locations in real estate transactions, financing, and operating agreements.
notable_facts: Offices in New York and Boston
Focus on Title IX and campus misconduct defense

email.subject: AI for NESENOFF & MILTENBERG, LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Title IX and employee discrimination defense demand precision and speed, especially when managing complex litigation across multiple jurisdictions. At a 15-attorney firm, your team is competing on expertise, not headcount.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York market to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
